prompts.text: A red bicycle leaning against a blue wall in warm afternoon light. A gentle breeze moves nearby leaves. The camera remains still.
A person wearing a blue jacket walks steadily from left to right along a park path. Their arms swing naturally. The camera remains still.
Gentle ripples travel across the surface of a quiet lake, reflecting green trees and a pale blue sky. The camera remains still.
The camera slowly pans across a row of colorful houses on a quiet street in daylight. Tree branches sway gently in the wind.
A brown dog trots from left to right across a grassy garden. Its legs move steadily and its tail swings. The camera remains still.
A small white boat moves slowly across a calm blue lake, leaving a gentle wake behind it. The camera remains still.
Yellow flowers in a ceramic vase stand on a wooden table near a window. A breeze gently moves a white curtain. The camera remains still.
The camera slowly moves forward along a tree-lined path. Sunlight creates shifting patterns on the ground and green leaves sway gently.
